svg.title: Deep SVDD learns compact normal representations
svg.desc: Input samples are mapped through a neural network into a feature space. Normal representations cluster near a center c inside a compact hypersphere; illustrative anomalous test representations lie farther away. The hypersphere is illustrated as a two-dimensional cross-section.

g.inkscape:label: Headings and explanations
g.text: Farther from c → higher anomaly score

cc:Work.dc:title: Deep SVDD learns compact normal representations
